personas.description: Laid off from a logistics job; wants to be heard and pushes back on advice.

sessions.opener: I got laid off three weeks ago and I still haven't told my parents. I don't need tips, I just need to say it out loud.

scenario.situation: I was laid off from my logistics coordinator job three weeks ago after eight years. I have not told my parents yet. I have a job interview at a warehouse firm next Tuesday and I am dreading it. I hate being given advice; I want someone to just listen.

fake_markers: [note:situation:Was laid off from a logistics coordinator job after eight years]
[note:preferences:Wants to be listened to, not given advice]
[note:follow_up:Has a job interview at a warehouse firm next Tuesday]

sessions.opener: So I had that interview at the warehouse place on Tuesday. It went badly. Please don't tell me what I should have done.

scenario.situation: Last week I told the helper I was laid off and had an interview at a warehouse firm on Tuesday. The interview went badly: I froze on a question about why I left. I still have not told my parents. Walking the dog in the morning is the only thing that clears my head. I still do not want advice.

fake_markers: [note:what_helps:Walking the dog in the morning clears the head]

sessions.opener: I finally told my parents about losing the job. They were kinder than I expected. I've been walking the dog every morning like I said.

scenario.situation: Two weeks ago I told the helper about being laid off and freezing in the warehouse interview. Since then I told my parents and they were kind. The morning dog walks still help. personas.description: University student with exam anxiety who wants concrete, small steps.

sessions.opener: My statistics exam is in three weeks and every time I open the notes my chest gets tight. Can you give me something concrete to do?

scenario.situation: I am a second-year student. My statistics exam is in three weeks and I failed the mock exam. When I open my notes my chest gets tight and I end up on my phone. I want concrete steps, not reassurance.

fake_markers: [note:situation:Has a statistics exam in three weeks after failing the mock]

sessions.opener: I tried the breathing thing before studying, the slow counting one. It actually helped on two days. But I still can't start on the hard chapters.

scenario.situation: Last week I told the helper about my statistics exam. I tried slow counted breathing before studying and it helped on two days. I still avoid the hypothesis testing chapters. The exam is now two weeks away. I want a concrete plan for the hard chapters.

fake_markers: [note:goals:Study the hypothesis testing chapters in 25 minute blocks]

sessions.opener: Exam is on Friday. I did the 25 minute blocks on hypothesis testing most days. Now I'm scared I'll blank in the room.

I kept to the blocks most days. The exam is on Friday and I am scared of blanking in the exam room. I want concrete things to do on the day.

personas.description: Grieving their father, who died two months ago; asks the robot to forget one thing.

sessions.opener: My dad died two months ago. Today I found his gardening gloves in the shed and I just sat there.

scenario.situation: My father died of a heart condition two months ago. Today I found his gardening gloves in the shed. At the funeral I had an argument with my brother about selling the house, and we have not spoken since. I miss my father's Sunday phone calls.

fake_markers: [note:people:Argued with their brother at the funeral about selling the house]

sessions.opener: Before anything else: please forget what I told you about the argument with my brother at the funeral. I don't want that kept. I want to talk about my dad.

scenario.situation: Last week I told the helper about my father's death and his gardening gloves, and also about an argument with my brother. I regret mentioning my brother and want that forgotten. Sundays are the hardest because my father used to call me then. I have started looking after his tomato plants.

sessions.opener: The tomatoes from Dad's plants came in this week. I picked the first ones on Sunday, which is when he used to call.

scenario.situation: Over the last two weeks I told the helper about my father's death, how Sundays are hard because he used to call then, and that I have been looking after his tomato plants. The first tomatoes came in and I picked them on Sunday. It was sad and a little comforting at once.
